runtimes.name: Real-ESRGAN NCNN/Vulkan
runtimes.notes: Official portable release, installed by scripts/install-realesrgan-linux.sh, which reads the archive_url and sha256 from this entry. Files are downloaded into .upscaler and are not committed.

weights.name: RealESRGAN_x4plus
weights.notes: The only weight the CUDA engine loads. General-purpose photo restoration; that engine deliberately offers no model choice, so no illustration variant is installed into it. Upstream publishes no digest; sha256 was computed from the official release download and pinned here.

weights.name: RealESRGAN x4plus anime 6B
weights.notes: Official x4 model optimized for anime illustrations. Installed into the user's ComfyUI upscale_models directory; the app uses it only in the explicit Illustration mode. Upstream publishes no digest; sha256 was computed from the official release asset and pinned here.

weights.name: SwinIR-L real-world x4 GAN
weights.notes: Preferred Upscale engine: a transformer, which is what every NTIRE 2026 x4 winner is built on, and specifically the variant trained with the BSRGAN degradation pipeline. The classical SwinIR/HAT/DRCT checkpoints are trained on bicubic downsampling and sharpen compression artifacts on real photographs, so the benchmark leaders are deliberately not pinned here. Any other spandrel-loadable checkpoint can be substituted via UPSCALER_SR_MODEL. Upstream publishes no digest; sha256 was computed from the official release download and pinned here.
